## How I work
- Automate > operate. Rule of two: any manual report or task done more than twice becomes a spec-driven pipeline.
- Reliability as a product. Downtime is measured by real user impact, not by ticket closure; blameless post-mortems; least-privilege runbooks.
- State outside the code. IDs, cut-offs and thresholds live in configuration (JSON / Notion) read alike by the workflow and the dashboard; the spec is the contract.
- Cursor over ingestion, not the clock. Designed for failure (missed runs, late data), not for the happy path.
- Spec-Driven Development (proposal → specs → design → tasks → apply → archive); the spec is the source of truth. AI as SDLC copilot: spec generation, static code analysis, automated debugging, RCA/post-mortems, documentation, AI Skills (e.g. ticket routing with human review on low confidence).
- Impact metrics: ~40% less code review time, 80% autonomous N1 incident resolution, first response under 10 minutes, critical resolution under 2 hours, 99.95% monthly uptime (July 2026).

Diagnoses and operates AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, CloudWatch Logs Insights, RDS) and audits error tracking (Sentry); SLAs: first response <10 min, critical resolution <2 h.

## Featured projects
- Fidello — Loyalty Card System (pilot, cloud beta): multi-business digital loyalty (stamps via QR, nothing to install); five actors (guest, registered customer, cashier, owner/manager, platform admin), multi-business wallet, tiers and redemptions, self-service business onboarding, KPIs/analytics, satisfaction surveys, scheduled monthly platform report (pg_cron). All business rules in PostgreSQL: multi-tenant RLS, RPC in PL/pgSQL SECURITY DEFINER, QR tokens with TTL + SHA-256 fingerprint (anti-replay), rate limiting on anonymous functions, PII-free audit log, feature flags (global + per-business). Core journeys validated by product in real coffee shops. Engineering: 793 tests (337 DB against real Postgres + 456 UI), 91 SQL migrations, 22 tables, 7 Edge Functions, 5 cron jobs, 97 OpenSpec changes, 28 journeys with twin runbooks, CI with 2 blocking jobs (frontend + DB), QAS/PROD environments, architecture review package for external reviewers. 100% SDD/OpenSpec with 5 specialized AI agents. Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5, Tailwind 3, React Router 7, PWA (Workbox), WCAG AA, html5-qrcode, Supabase (PostgreSQL 15, Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Edge Functions/Deno, pg_cron), Vitest + Testing Library + msw + pg harness, ESLint, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Supabase CLI + Docker. Private repository.

Grafana tickets & SLA dashboards. Built with SDD; runs locally via Docker. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/Trackion. Stack: Python 3.12, AWS Lambda, API Gateway (HTTP API), Serverless Framework, PostgreSQL (pg8000), JWT (PyJWT), SSM Parameter Store, Grafana, vanilla JS.

API on API Gateway + Lambda; frontend on S3 + CloudFront. Live demo: https://d3rw1q49m6mvnq.cloudfront.net/. Stack: Python, FastAPI, JWT, SQLite/PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront.
- Monitoreo-Cloud — self-hosted observability stack (Grafana + Docker) over three sources: AWS serverless (Lambda/S3 via CloudWatch), local Docker containers, and Trackion's tickets/SLA. Automated collection with n8n + a read-only IAM role. SDD. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/monitoreo-cloud. Stack: Grafana, Docker, n8n, PostgreSQL, AWS CloudWatch, Lambda, S3.
- dataMasterGK — retail ETL middleware that automates master-data integration into GK Software: watches directories, transforms Excel → GK XML (stores, operators, promotions) and transmits via SFTP/FTP, with a Flask web panel (config/operation/audit), scheduler and SQLite auditing. Re-engineered under SDD (idempotent single-pass pipeline, pooled SFTP/SQLite connections, security hardening). Code: https://github.com/jalducin/dataMasterGK. Stack: Python 3.12, Flask, Pandas, openpyxl, SQLite, Paramiko (SFTP), Jinja2.
